parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action that is performed when the rule is hit. Valid values:

*   **1**: alert
*   **2**: block

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the rule. You do not need to manually specify the ID.

parameters.name: RuleSwitch
parameters.description:
The switch of the rule. Valid values:

*   **0**: off
*   **1**: on

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:

*   2: user-defined rules

> Only the value 2 is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-container-defense-rule --rule-id 500018 --rule-action 1 --rule-switch 1 --rule-name auto-test-rule-lt9umq --description test-proc-defense --rule-type 2 --whitelist '{"Path":["/test/worker.sh"],"Hash":["hashcode"],"Image":["repo:tag"]}' --scope '[{"Namespaces":["default"],"ClusterId":"8e200075b","AllNamespace":0}]' --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
